clips.title: The story
paras: Priestess Alathea calls promising night elf priests back to Darnassus. The summons brings them to the Temple of the Moon to be recognized by the Sisterhood of Elune and receive advanced guidance.

A messenger from the Sisterhood reaches you while you visit Nara Meideros in Stormwind's Park. You have served your people abroad, and the order's leaders now require you in Darnassus. They have watched your spiritual growth and call you back for an evaluation and a rite of recognition. The journey marks your passage from a new initiate to an active servant of the Mother Moon.

The summons sends you to Priestess Alathea at the Temple of the Moon, Darnassus's highest sanctuary. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind oversees the Sisterhood, which watches over its members wherever they serve. Your safe return to the temple honors your community and Elune. It also shows that the goddess's grace has guided and preserved you through your early trials in the wild.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh, yes, of course. Hello, friend. A messenger from our order was here not too long ago looking for you. She mentioned something important happening back in Darnassus and that you should return to the Temple of the Moon as soon as you can. When you arrive, speak to Priestess Alathea. I believe it has something to do with your progressing so well in our ways.
Again, return to Darnassus when you can.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful, you've returned home, friend. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
